request: Search online for the normal integration pattern, rather than only explaining individual permission definitions.
scope: Read-only primary-source research. No claim about market adoption percentages, new product approval, remote configuration, build or upload.
preferredDocumentedIntegration: For an iOS AdMob app that deliberately supports IDFA, use the certified UMP consent flow and its configured IDFA/ATT message integration instead of inventing a second blanket privacy override or copying a partial manual consent parser.

sources.section: FAQ: best practice for showing ATT and GDPR
sources.finding: Google recommends GDPR consent first and ATT afterward if consent was given; it states UMP handles this when both messages are configured. Manual ATT integrations must separately evaluate the collected choices.
The documented UMP IDFA integration requires message configuration, purpose text in the plist and the Apple tracking framework. Refusal still permits eligible ads without IDFA.
The preceding message varies with region and existing choices; an EU message can replace the separate IDFA explainer. Do not assume every person sees three separate dialogs.
The official consent example refreshes UMP on launch, loads/presents required forms and exposes privacy options. The SDK path is the reference; canRequestAds remains request eligibility.
PPT is optional and .disabled adds an app-wide personalization restriction; the most restrictive privacy signal takes precedence.
Publisher first-party ID is enabled by default. Its disablement is an optional publisher decision and is separate from ATT/IDFA.
Permission wording must explain the actual use; no manipulative explainer or functionality blocked on tracking approval.

applicationToTarot: Recommend this documented optional-personalization flow for the advertising goal, reconciling privacy disclosures and testing both refusals and revocation. The prepared removal-only 1.2.1 is partial. Current pinned SDK support and the real rejection path must be verified before enabling/distributing any changed tracking behavior; this research does not replace native QA or authorize it by itself.
clarificationToEarlierAudit: Earlier records cautioned against assuming remote IDFA configuration safely coordinates a European refusal. The current official FAQ explicitly documents that coordination. Prefer the documented integration and verify its actual behavior, rather than treating uncertainty alone as a reason to implement a custom partial gate.
